a_before_b.rationale: Understanding model-level inference optimization techniques like quantization and distillation is not required to define parameter-efficient finetuning or explain how adapter-based methods like LoRA reduce compute and memory compared to full finetuning.

b_before_a.rationale: Knowing how parameter-efficient finetuning works is not necessary to meaningfully understand model-level inference optimization techniques such as quantization and distillation, as they address different stages of the model lifecycle.
